PASS_scope: CODE/math authority audit only; no original teacher/GT/pixel payload verification, relabeling or admission

population_authority.source: Existing PUBLIC_YCB_GT_JITTER_EMULATION, conditional associated-surface AUX; not a new teacher
population_authority.unique_frame_count_authority: Existing V227 interface census, not newly recomputed from row bodies
population_authority.native_mapping: UNKNOWN; logical_aux_slot k / aux_surface_id is not a pallet native/canonical-part crosswalk

q_r_definition.r: Fixed source mesh candidate X_k transformed by SOURCE instance R,t to P_k; r=project_K(P_k), camera depth Z=P_k[2], range rho=||P_k||. Saved reference_xy is GT-only. No query-based point reselection.
q_r_definition.q: q=r+4*sqrt(u1)*(cos(2*pi*u0),sin(2*pi*u0)); fixed PCG64 seed207, independent 8x2 draws per instance. Existing saved q must be reused, not regenerated or recentered.
q_r_definition.teacher_evidence_location: Reference r and floor(r+.5), not literal jittered q
q_r_definition.L: native_grid(q,raw_hw): clip(.25*max(ptp(finite q8,axis=0)),16,max(H,W)); fallback16 if fewer than2 finite points. Grid is 9x9 about q, not a RAW96 packet.
q_r_definition.context_box: Unexpanded min/max saved q8; not GT instance ROI
q_r_definition.bounds: q_cont:0<=qx<W and0<=qy<H. r_cont same. nearest pixel=floor(x+.5). q_cont/r_cont/q_nearest/r_nearest are separately stored; [-.5,W-.5) RAW96-sampler canvas is not silently substituted.
q_r_definition.q_availability: No original initializer-availability field is established here. q_nearest is a separate diagnostic; classification does not require q_nearest valid if q_cont valid. No invented original-U replacement.

geometry_math.ray: Target-alone source CAD, camera origin0, unit direction P_k/||P_k||; double-sided Moller-Trumbore, original triangle order, t>0. No observed foreign geometry ray.
geometry_math.used_sensitivities: Producer compact_ray uses primary64eps and1e-10; exact-zero sensitivity remains helper-level but is not used in the two-value geometry_state check.
geometry_math.first_hit_stability: Both first ranges finite and abs(first64eps-first1e-10)<=0.001mm; otherwise geometry UNKNOWN.
geometry_math.signed_gap: gap=rho-first64eps. gap>2mm -> SELF; abs(gap)<=2mm -> SELF_VISIBLE; gap<−2mm -> UNKNOWN. Stored primary gap, no new threshold.
geometry_math.nearest_r_ray: Separate target-alone ray K^-1*[floor(r+.5),1], first-hit camera Z. D depth agreement uses primary first-hit camera Z on this integer-pixel ray, not rho or directly Z(P_k).
geometry_math.ties: 256*FP64eps*max(1,target_range,max camera vertex range); helper preserves incident-triangle and tie evidence, but classify() does not add an incident-membership gate.

label_rules_in_exact_order.rule: If q_cont false, then r_cont false, then reference nearest pixel centre outside image; preserve exact respective reasons.
Known target-alone SELF geometry; this branch runs before observed-depth/owner D/E tests, after q/r bound checks. S is never E.
Geometry other than SELF_VISIBLE (and not preceding SELF) remains U.

Centre of reference3x3 is unique target-visible owner and positive depth; nearest-r target ray first-hit cameraZ finite; abs(observed_depth_mm-centre_first_Z)<=15mm; unique-own count>=5 AND positive-depth count>=5. The two counts are independent, not a required intersection of the same5 cells.

All9 reference-neighborhood cells inbounds, each visible owner_count==1, no target-visible cell, all owner bitsets equal (same foreign instance). Centre positive depth; centre and all positive neighbors satisfy depth_mm<reference_Z−15mm; positive count>=7; target full/amodal mask is positive in at least one neighborhood cell. Foreign presence/absence alone is insufficient.

Then preserve owner overlap, centre zero depth, missing target centre-ray hit, own centre depth disagreement, foreign without amodal support, foreign not strictly nearer-supported, unassigned centre, insufficient fixed3x3 support reasons. Do not convert any to background/E.

neighborhood_and_observed_arrays.window: dy outer,dx inner in[-1,0,1]; centre index4; nearest r=floor(r+.5)
neighborhood_and_observed_arrays.raw_depth: SOURCE depth image uint16[H,W], >0 means positive; mm=raw_uint16*source depth_scale. No inference that zero depth is empty space.
neighborhood_and_observed_arrays.owner: All scene_gt entries (<=64) and all corresponding mask_visib images [H,W], binary0/255. owner_count=sum(mask>0); uint64 bits bit i=scene_gt instance index. Unique own additionally requires own_visible. No GT-best/first-instance fallback.
neighborhood_and_observed_arrays.own_full: Selected source instance mask_full [H,W], binary0/255; amodal any in E rule. This is not nativepart anatomy.
neighborhood_and_observed_arrays.identity_checks: source_instance index/object/pose and camera K/depth_scale must exactly match scene GT/camera metadata in producer; this audit does not reopen their payloads.

saved_arrays.geometry: geometry_state U16 / stable bool[1000,8]; first-hit range/Z/gap [1000,8,2]; nearest-r ray first Z [1000,8,2]
saved_arrays.neighborhood: raw uint16[1000,8,9], inbounds/full/own-visible bool same; visible owner count uint8 same, owner bits uint64 same
saved_arrays.other: reference_xy_GT_only/query_xy_input_copy[1000,8,2]; roi_side[1000]; separate q/r continuous/nearest validity[1000,8]; scale andframe-index[1000]

payload_pointers_inert_not_accessed.source_frame_schema: source_instance.depth / mask_full; scene=parent(depth).parent; scene_gt.json,scene_camera.json; mask_visib/<frame:06d>_<sceneGTindex:06d>.png. Exact per-frame file SHAs reside in sealed bindings, not inferred/fabricated here.

authorities_to_keep_separate.contract: Same existing input_id+instance_row_index+logical_aux_slot+aux_surface_id and saved r define the unchanged target. Retain original D/E/S/U and reasons at r; a q-side observation does not overwrite/relabel them.

Future observation at saved q may record q continuous/nearest inbounds, q-window owner/depth/presence and availability as separate fields with separate evidence location. It describes q pixel/window, not automatically visibility of associated surface r or pallet native.

The saved ||q−r||<=4px is constructed GT-jitter distance, not actual initializer accuracy or independent deployment-quality gold. Quantization/window overlap can differ even at this distance; this audit computes no new values.
Known target SELF remains S; uncertain geometry/depth/ownership/part mapping stays U. Never S→E, missing/absent→E or nativeUNKNOWN→pallet label.

Preserve saved q8/L/input crop. GT r/model/pose/depth/masks/instance-selected region are teacher-side evidence, not deployment input channels or a GT crop selector. Original RGB q8 context is a separate input observation.

unknowns: No original GT, instances/reference/slot-label body, NPZ, depth/mask/RGB, CAD or modelweights accessed; existing values/counts are not independently reverified.
No q-local owner/depth sidecar currently certified by this code read; actual raw evidence and exact future whitelist/scope would be needed for a later observation.
No new physical pallet native/part mapping; source mesh surface identity and human pallet-native semantics differ.
No RAW96 source packet or RGB sampling verification supplied by V109 teacher math; native_grid only supplies q-grid/side.
Numeric source tolerance rules do not establish natural-image physical mesh accuracy or real generalization.
